svg.title: State changes of the Counter contract
svg.desc: Five circles show count: 0 after deploy, 1 after increment, 0 after reset, 1 after an increment with a 1 wei tip, 2 after an increment with a 2 wei tip. Notes: reads are free; reset does not erase history and only the owner may call it.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Counter state changes (the real order on Sepolia)
